capabilities: Insert function plots via an inline builder or modal form
Plot 2D functions, 3D surfaces, parametric curves, ODE/PDE solutions and data points
Render graphs as SVG in Reading View from JSON blocks
Rotate, zoom and drag plotted points interactively
Export graphs as SVG or PNG
extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop. Octave and LuaLaTeX are optional fallback renderers, off by default; the README notes the plugin never touches the system clipboard.
problem: Plotting math graphs in Obsidian normally requires learning and writing TikZ, PGFPlots or Octave code instead of filling in a form.

relations.evidence: Octave, if you enable it, samples numerically through octave-cli and feeds CSV data to PGFPlots
TikZJax (bundled WebAssembly) compiles the generated PGFPlots
LuaLaTeX is a last-resort fallback for plots TikZJax can't compile

summary: Form-based math graph builder that inserts 2D, 3D, parametric, ODE/PDE and data plots into notes as JSON blocks rendered as SVG.
